# TextMesh Pro Essential Resources

Imported the original Essential Resources archive from Unity Technologies' uGUI repository, Unity 6000.0 branch. The official package manifest identifies `com.unity.ugui` version `2.0.0`, matching this project's manifest. No Examples and Extras were imported.

- [Official source archive](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Unity-Technologies/uGUI/08a19d2cb9de6bfaefbd2e301ac9e5518a78fc6d/com.unity.ugui/Package%20Resources/TMP%20Essential%20Resources.unitypackage)
- Source commit: `08a19d2cb9de6bfaefbd2e301ac9e5518a78fc6d`
- Archive SHA-256: `58564ec64cef8a8cea3d0b8ffb5e6fecf4176d544a2f6a29a2b43a0a33256431`
- Archive size: 941,722 bytes
- Imported: 37 assets and 8 folders, with all 45 original `.meta` files and GUIDs retained byte-for-byte.
- The import receipt in [TMP-Essential-Resources.import.json](TMP-Essential-Resources.import.json) records every asset and metadata digest.

The archive supplies the default TMP Settings, LiberationSans font and materials, line-breaking data, style sheet, sprite resource, and TMP shaders. Importing these files is a resource preparation step; Unity import, shader compilation, glyph rendering, and player builds still require verification in Unity.

## Licenses and attribution

- The official package's [Unity UI license notice](Unity-UI-LICENSE.md) is preserved unchanged.
- The bundled LiberationSans font's complete SIL Open Font License is preserved at `WSliceProto/Assets/TextMesh Pro/Fonts/LiberationSans - OFL.txt`.
- The package's EmojiOne attribution is preserved at `WSliceProto/Assets/TextMesh Pro/Sprites/EmojiOne Attribution.txt`.
